title: Scribblebox — your kid's drawing as an 'official' toy box, cereal box or book cover
oneLiner: For parents and grandparents with a child's drawing and a gift deadline, it turns a photo of the drawing into a funny boxed 'official product' with a print-ready file for $9–$19, instead of $18–$100+ for slow physical keepsakes.
overlaps: alterpaw (pet photo to funny poster/card bundle) and giftlet (personal gift site) share the cheap personalised-gift pattern but use pet photos and a site, not kids' drawings; no portfolio repo covers kids' art
